description.value:
You launch a grappling wire at a creature you can see within 30 feet, making a melee tech attack against it. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 kinetic damage, and if it is Large or smaller, you pull it up to 10 feet toward you.

This power's damage increases to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th level, and 4d6 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
